notes.title: Straight Up Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
Update:


 Drops UI has been added
 A way point for the end has been added


In this update, the tutorial has been improved. Now you can see how many drops need to be collected and how many you have already collected. Furthermore, an additional waypoint has been added so that you know where to go after collecting all the drops.

notes.title: The release date has been changed
notes.notes:
Exciting news is on the horizon! We are delighted to inform you that the release of "Straight Up" has been moved forward by a few days. Originally scheduled for February 29, 2024, the game will now be available on January 31, 2024!

The earlier release allows us to make the game accessible to you more quickly, as it is already nearly ready. We appreciate your patience and look forward to you diving into the captivating world of "Straight Up" very soon.

So, mark your calendars for January 31, 2024, and get ready to experience this thrilling adventure. We value your support and can't wait for you to enjoy "Straight Up.
